title: A song becomes its music video
pitch: Lyrics in. A sung song, one invented character, four moving shots and a cut timed to the song's own beats out.
why: The song decides everything after it. Music 3 writes the performance, Klein keeps one face through every keyframe, H3 moves each frame, and the cut lands where the beat tracker found the beats.

fields.label: Lyrics, with [verse] and [chorus] on their own lines
fields.default:
[intro]

[verse]
I keep the lamp when the harbour sleeps
Salt on my hands and the promise it keeps
Nobody's sailing, nobody's near
I turn the light so you know I'm here
[chorus]
Burn on, burn on, over the black water
Burn on, burn on, till the morning comes
Every wave I count is a mile I've carried you
Burn on, burn on, I will bring you home
[outro]

fields.label: Who it is about
fields.default: a woman in her forties with short silver hair and a weathered face, a long rust-orange oilskin coat over a dark green fisherman's sweater, heavy black boots

fields.label: Where it happens
fields.default: a tall black-and-white lighthouse on a storm-worn rock in a dark cold sea, the only light for miles

Upload your own song on the first stage to skip it.

steps.label: The song
steps.does: Writes the performance from the lyrics: the voice, the band and the beats every later stage is timed to.
steps.prompt:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 84. key is A, and scale is minor. Cinematic folk rock.
Global Emotional Progression: A lone voice and acoustic guitar open quietly, then drums and strings lift the chorus into something huge.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: {world}.
Sonics & Production Profile: Close, warm vocal, wide room, deep low end.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A (Female), husky and steady.
Vocal Style: Intimate in the verse, open and strong in the chorus.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: Soft stacked harmonies on the chorus.
Vocal FX: Light hall reverb.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: Acoustic guitar, low piano.
Secondary: Strings and a slow-building drum kit.
Groove & Foundation Progression: A clear 84 BPM pulse from the first bars, full drums on the chorus.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Swells and rises into each new section.

steps.label: The character
steps.does: One invented person, drawn once, used as the reference for every shot.
steps.prompt: Full body character design: {character}. Standing, facing the camera, the whole figure in frame, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos.

steps.label: Keyframe 1

75:74.text: The same woman as in the reference picture, same face, same hair, same clothing and colours. Extreme wide shot at night. A tall black-and-white lighthouse on a storm-worn rock, huge waves breaking, she is a small figure on the iron gallery at the top, one sweep of amber light across the sea. Film still, anamorphic, deep teal shadows, warm amber lamp light, 35mm grain. No text, no logos.
